name: Pineapple Bun
desc: warm. sweet. the crust crackles. uncle chen makes them right.

name: Congee
desc: rice porridge. plain. exactly what you need when everything else isn't.

name: Kuncheng Commute Card
desc: gets you on the bus. sometimes the bus takes you somewhere the card didn't intend.

name: Work ID Card
desc: an ID card. the photo is someone who looks like you but younger. or maybe that is you.

name: Bandage
desc: a basic bandage. fixes scrapes. doesn't fix whatever that is.

name: Herbal Tea
desc: bitter. the kind of bitter that means business. guangdong business.

name: Resonance Shard
desc: it hums when you hold it. it hums louder near certain things. don't hold it too long.

name: Brain Platinum (Authentic)
desc: the real stuff. extends life. probably. the label says so. the label is very confident.

name: Unlabeled Box
desc: from grandma's cabinet. you don't know what's inside. you're not sure you want to.

name: Abacus
desc: old wooden abacus. the beads move on their own sometimes. usually when the deal is bad.
